result: At pixel_values [784,1536] and grid_thw [1,28,28], one PyTorch pass and one TensorRT execution completed with matching [196,2048] output shapes, but all four outputs on both sides were non-finite. name: Qwen3-VL vision non-finite diagnosis
baseline: Phase 9.2-C2 non-finite fixed-boundary outputs
result: Direct CUDA FP16 linspace used by Phase 9.2-C2 produced only 131040 finite elements out of 1204224 (1073184 NaNs). FP16 instability was NOT_REPRODUCED, input/boundary mismatch was SUPPORTED / C2_CUDA_FP16_LINSPACE_NONFINITE, and submodule instability was NOT_OBSERVED

name: Qwen3-VL end-to-end TensorRT vision integration harness
